findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_hero_paths" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Retrieve every publicly published VA Heroes PH Hero Path — the career and training tracks a Filipino virtual assistant can start with or specialise in — so an a…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_hero_paths, get_hero_path, get_program_information, get_site_information · Private data: get_hero_paths, get_hero_path, get_site_information · Public sink: get_hero_paths, get_hero_path.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_hero_paths, get_hero_path, get_program_information, get_site_information · Private data: get_hero_paths, get_hero_path, get_site_information · Public sink: get_hero_paths, get_hero_path

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
